edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Every pumping station has at least two pumps.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Raw water pumping station: firm capacity (largest pump out of service) must convey the treatment facility design flow.
applies_to: sim: station firm capacity vs design flow

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Finished-water and booster stations should deliver max-day demand (plus largest fire flow where fire protection is provided) with the largest pump out of service.
applies_to: sim: firm capacity at system curve

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: With any pump out of service, remaining pumps must meet maximum pumping demand while holding minimum system pressure (8.2.1, 20 psi).

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Avoid suction lift; if unavoidable keep it preferably under 15 ft and provide priming.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Dedicated standby power so water can be treated and/or pumped to meet average day demand during outages.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Distribution system holds at least 20 psi at ground level at all points under all flow conditions.
applies_to: sim: node pressures incl. fire flow

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Normal working pressure should be about 60-80 psi and not less than 35 psi.
applies_to: sim: node pressures at average day

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Where static pressure exceeds 100 psi, pressure reducing devices are required.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Minimum water main diameter 6 in where fire protection/hydrants are served; 3 in where no fire protection.
applies_to: pipe diameters (input); 3 in if no hydrants

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Air relief valves required at high points of water mains where air can accumulate.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Intake influent velocity 0.5 ft/s or less where frazil ice may form.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Rapid mix: instantaneous, not longer than 30 s, with velocity gradient G of at least 750 /s.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Flocculation detention time should be at least 30 minutes.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Flow-through velocity in flocculation basins 0.5 to 1.5 ft/min.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Conventional sedimentation provides at least 4 h settling time (reductions only with demonstration or SOR <= 0.5 gpm/sf).

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Horizontal velocity through sedimentation basin should not exceed 0.5 ft/min.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Outlet weir/launder or submerged orifice collector loading not more than 20,000 gpd per ft.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Typical rapid-rate gravity filtration rates 2 to 4 gpm/sf; any rate must be justified to the reviewing authority (advisory range, not a hard cap).

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: At least two filters; with more than two, design capacity met with the largest filter out of service.
applies_to: filter count x area x rate

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Filter box at least 8.5 ft deep with at least 3 ft of water over the media.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Backwash rate at least 15 gpm/sf (20 gpm/sf or 50% bed expansion recommended).

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Clearwell has at least two compartments (50% isolatable); sized for disinfectant contact time.

edition: Recommended Standards for Water Works, 2022 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Hydropneumatic tank gross volume (gal) at least 10 x largest pump capacity (gpm), unless VFDs etc. meet max demand.

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Multiple pumps; with any unit out of service the remaining units handle design peak hourly flow; with two units both equal size.

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Wet well effective volume based on design average flow and fill time not exceeding 30 min; minimum cycle time per pump maker's duty cycle.
applies_to: wet well volume between on/off levels

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Suction-lift stations: dynamic suction lift at pump-off plus NPSHr at design conditions not more than 22 ft.

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Emergency pumping capability (unless storage prevents overflow), able to start and maintain total rated running capacity; portable pump connection always provided.

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Force main cleansing velocity at design pumping rate at least 2 ft/s.
applies_to: sim: velocity at design pump rate

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Force main velocity at most 8 ft/s recommended (head loss, valve protection).

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Raw wastewater force main diameter not less than 4 in.

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Air relief valves at force main high points; evaluate vacuum relief.

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Hazen-Williams design C = 100 for unlined iron/steel; not more than 120 for PVC, PE, lined DI.
applies_to: friction model input (100 for unlined iron/steel)

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Primary settling surface overflow rate not over 1,000 gpd/sf at design average flow (1,500-2,000 at peak hourly; 700/1,200 if receiving WAS).

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Activated sludge final clarifier SOR not over 1,200 gpd/sf at peak hourly flow (1,000 extended aeration); peak solids loading <= 40 lb/d/sf.

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Clarifier weir loading at peak hourly flow: <= 20,000 gpd/ft for plants <= 1 mgd; <= 30,000 gpd/ft above 1 mgd.
applies_to: weir length / flow (20000 if plant <= 1 mgd)

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Minimum side water depth 10 ft primary, 12 ft secondary after activated sludge.
applies_to: clarifier geometry (12 ft for AS secondary)

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Settling tank freeboard at least 12 in; walls at least 6 in above surrounding grade.

edition: Recommended Standards for Wastewater Facilities, 2014 Edition (GLUMRB Ten States Standards)
rule: Chlorine contact at least 15 min at design peak hourly flow after thorough mixing.

edition: ANSI/HI 9.6.3 (paywalled) as summarized by Pumps & Systems, S. Christofi, 16 Jan 2026
rule: Preferred operating region generally 70-120% of BEP flow (80-120% for Ns > 4,500 US units); rated point ideally 80-110% of BEP. Secondary-source citation, not the standard text.
applies_to: sim: each operating pump duty point
